regions.name: South Georgia and South Sandwich Is.

recipe.ghg_method: Fossil CO2 summed across seven native fuel accounts. Source Mt CO2eq converted to tonnes using 1e6. CO2 has GWP 1 under AR5 and AR6; no CH4, N2O or F-gases are included. No direct final-demand emissions are supplied.
recipe.gdp_basis: GDP proxy: value added (no product-tax detail in source)
recipe.gdp_note: EMERGING: GDP is approximated by value added. The source table does not break out product taxes, so no adjustment to market prices is applied.
recipe.value_added_note: Sum of the native value added row. The source table does not break out product taxes separately.
recipe.attribution: Huo, J.; Chen, P.; Hubacek, K.; Zheng, H.; Meng, J.; Guan, D. EMERGING 1.0, 2017. doi:10.5281/zenodo.10956623. CC BY 4.0; indicators calculated with MARIO.
recipe.ghg_basis: Fossil CO2 by fuel; incomplete GHG proxy
recipe.gwp_basis: CO2 only (GWP = 1 under AR5 and AR6)
recipe.ghg_note: EMERGING: GHG is a fossil CO2-only proxy (seven fuel accounts). CH4, N2O, F-gases and direct final-demand emissions are not included.
